notes: Page 079. Arke at top = arke of John of Tseylem (day 19, p078 ended with no arke). Numeral ፳፮ inferred from running sequence (p078 ended ፳፭); the Ge'ez ¶፳፮ is the commemoration of the martyrs of Metra and King Yimrehane Kristos (second ወበዛቲ ዕለት on day 19), followed by its arke. Third arke (ሰላም ለስምዖን መንፈሰ ትንቢት) has no matching story on this page or p078: subject (Simeon / disciple John) unresolved, to be checked against the PDF; it is attached by position to ¶፳፮. Day 20 opens at ¶፩ (አመ ፳ሁ ለጥቅምት): Abba John Hagir (ሐጊር read from both Ge'ez and Amharic scan; meaning to confirm). Ge'ez flags: ይምርሐነ (scan reads ይምርሐን in Amharic, ይምርሐነ kept in Ge'ez), ማዕሰ (sic, as scanned, unclear), ኢተሌለየ, ወኢኮነ (scan ኮኑ/ኮነ ambiguous, read ኮነ), ሆከቶ (sic), ወሶቢ read ወሶቢ vs scan ወሶቦ-like (kept ወሶቢ), ወኢ፡ብዕል spacing as scanned. Amharic flags: ይምርሐነ ክርስቶስ (Amharic scan reads ይምርሐን; normalised to match Ge'ez, inferred), ቸኑር (likely ይኑር, kept as scanned), አነግሥታው (sic, scan reads አነግሥታው; probably አነሣሥቶት), ይሸውም (sic, probably ይህውም/ይህም), ሃያ for ፳ in the Amharic opener is the scan's ordinal as read. Arke 2: ዓሙ, ተኀትሙ, ተደሙ, ተክዕወ, ወንጥበ kept as scanned; line breaks of the arke resolved by comparing wide crop. Arke 1: ጽጉያ kept as scanned. Right edges of Amharic lines may be hidden by binding shadow. Page ends mid-sentence in ¶፬ (Ge'ez: ዛቲ ገዳም / Amharic: አይደለም); continues on p080 with trailing space then join. PDF cross-check pending.
